notes.title: Recent Patch notes
notes.content:
1. General Fixes and Improvements
[list]
[*] Improved AI pathfinding and movement behavior.
[*] Enhanced overall game performance.
[*] Fixed the end screen to correctly show which units are still alive at the end of each round.
[*] Added the ability to cancel vehicle purchases to prevent accidental buys.
[*] Introduced a slow money trickle for all Tier 0 bases (a full economy overhaul is planned for future updates).
[*] Increased money collection rate from money generators.
[*] Reduced stamina drain while running for a smoother gameplay flow.
[/list]
2. MIRCA Faction Adjustments
[list]
[*] Adjusted the POV for MIRCA special units to improve visibility while crouching and crawling.
[*] MIRCA turrets now properly downgrade to the MIRCA Tier 0 turret instead of the default one.
[*] Fixed an issue with the MIRCA grenade unit not receiving correct grenade upgrades.
[/list]
3. Gameplay and Level Fixes
[list]
[*] Nerfed the Rain Rifel, the kilbots' starting gun
[*] Fixed some achievements that weren't working
[*] Resolved an issue where lamp posts and certain buildings and crates couldn’t be destroyed.
[*] Fixed a bug where leveling up would override equipped weapons.
[*] Fixed turret buildings downgrading incorrectly, leaving the turret behind.
[*] Fixed issues with building positions across the Figure 8, Depths, and other levels along with various small level tweaks and fixes.
[*] Made additional fixes to tutorial sequences.
[/list]

We're going to try and keep pushing bug fixes separate from the major content updates when we can. We're pretty proud of this update cuz we finally found some of the culprits of our most recent performance problems, and we even fixed some of our old ones. We're still brainstorming other fixes that we hope to release.

For a while, the Update notes and the Discord have been our only way of dropping lore. We experimented with some story tools in the tutorial, but that has consistently also been our most broken level. I've played through the tutorial too many times to count, including this morning, and it's working. You can use escape to get out of some of the instructional content, but I kinda like some of the jokes and Easter eggs we've managed to fit in there. 

We hope you enjoy playing

notes.title: M.I.R.C.A.
notes.content:
In the annals of history, only one war was greater than The Great War—It's sequel, The Great War: The Rewaring!*

And what better way to market our finest WMDs than with the timeless, battle-tested iconography of those legendary conflicts?

War isn’t just about WMDs and profit margins though—it’s about style. Nothing completes the battlefield aesthetic quite like gas masks and stick grenades. Your bot armies will exude pure retro authenticity in our mass-produced battle-worn gear.

Back in the day, every man, woman and child had a gas mask. Robo-archeologists believe these masks held deep religious significance, carried as sacred relics of a bygone age. Now, you can bring that historical reverence to your warzones. An excellent conversation starter, and a great way to ensure that the last thing your enemies feel is jealousy.

For all your warmongering needs, M.I.R.C.A. is here.
Because history repeats itself, and War Never Goes Out of Style.™️

REAL CUSTOMER REVIEWS:

"The M.I.R.C.A. RealWood Grenade Handle™️ is perfect for wrapping my claws around!" -GRN-85042
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

"My new DELUXE™️ Designer Tank Treads are the talk of my entire platoon! Thanks, M.I.R.C.A.!" -INF-401982
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

"....." -YOUR ENEMIES!
⭐ ☆  ☆  ☆  ☆

M.I.R.C.A. Faction Features
[list]
[*]  Custom art for all turrets and buildings
[*]  First faction with a unique turret
[*]  Hero Unit starts in every squad, equipped with: Rifle and Grenade Launcher
[/list]
[hr][/hr]
Other Fixes, Updates, and Announcements:

✔ Fixed some issues with the tutorial
✔ Added reloading animations
✔ Building explosions no longer hurt units
✔ Work-in-progress AI physics-based player-like movement (allows for AI to use Jump, roll, etc).
✔ Planes now navigate more smoothly and recover more easily from obstructions
✔ Fixed contextual squad commands and added UI elements to communicate Squad actions
✔ Fixed AI squad movement freeze
✔ Steam Achievements are live! We’re glad to see players unlocking them
✔ Database and Lore unlocks tied to achievements
✔ FrompTec rebranding changes to remove distasteful letters
✔ Minor level changes
✔ Minor performance fixes

Performance and Optimization

Here at FrompTec, we are aware that even the most cutting-edge computers can grind to a halt in the theater of war. You may not notice the fixes we've already done, but we are researching more impactful ways to optimize performance.

Don’t count on anything monumental yet, but we thank you for your patience and support.

[hr][/hr]
*The IP formerly known as WWII has been purchased by FrompTec and rebranded. We think you’ll enjoy this war much more with a BioBurger and a side of Fromp.

🔥 For a limited time, every Bioburger Miniature Consumer Meal comes with a M.I.R.C.A. Grenade Launcher. Click once to launch a grenade, and again to trigger its explosion. 🔥

notes.title: THE Little TANK UPDATE
notes.content:
We know you've waited a long time for this one, so let's get in and take a look at the changes:

New Building Mechanic: Support Structures. Building nodes have always had occasional linked nodes, but we’ve added new functionality to linked nodes. Some of the nodes may be used to purchase vehicles. To purchase a vehicle, just construct a base on the closest node to a Support structure, then visit the support structure and press B. this opens the buying menu. Once a new vehicle is crafted, use E to hop into one of the seats.

[b]New Support Structures:[/b]
Vehicle Depot: builds Carts, 4 Wheelers, Skidos, Tanks, and Bot-Semple
Airstrip: Supports 3 different aircraft

[b]New Land Vehicles:[/b]
Tank
Bot-Semple Tank (Dross faction Only)
MiniCart

[b]New Aircraft[/b], each plane is the same small tactical vehicle, but it comes with three loadouts:
Rockets
Laser Guided Missiles
Laser Guided Bomb

[b]New Turret type:[/b] Anti Tank. The AT Turret is constructible by upgrading the Frag Turret.

[b]New Levels:[/b]

Close Quarters: a small and dark city based map.

Red Skies: Disaster has struck the FrompTech Kill Bot factory and training facility! Clear out the invaders, or finish the hostile take over. This is also the first level to support 5 factions, so give that a try.

We also added small adjustments to the old levels to accommodate Vehicle construction, and Teleporters just for fun.

[b]Teleporters:[/b] Careful, teleportation can be a little unpredictable.

We adjusted the Bridge Level to support 5 factions at a time and teleporter travel.

[b]AI Assistant.[/b] The AI assistant is available to manage your base infrastructure when you don’t want to. Just open In-Game Escape Menu by pressing the Escape Key. and select “Enable Assistant Manager”. Now a manager bot will handle your base building purchases using your faction’s Fromp-Coin.

[b]Difficulty Control.[/b] You can choose a factions difficulty in the Skirmish Menu:
Easy: reduced Income.
Normal: same as it ever was!
Hard: added a trickle of income and reduced a reaction speed limiter.
Cheat: like the hard mode, but they have all the money available and completely removed the limiter.

There have been many other bug fixes and quality of life adjustments, and we streamlined the Tutorial allowing the player to skip certain parts to have more freedom to explore the FrompTech Quality Assurance Gauntlet.

notes.title: Un-Hallowed Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41009805/c0782e96c7073bb40a64161c9eb890897a9d4d8a.png[/img]
We’ve smashed all the pumpkins and tossed the skulls into the void. The killbots rolled up all their toilet paper, and repackaged it for the upcoming Black-Friday sales. The Reaperbots went back to reaping, leaving their angel and demon costumes behind. Bigbots, Neobots, and Medicbots boxed up their costumes, and the snipers put their tutus in the closet. The Commando bot still likes to wear his kabuto from time to time, and the Dross will always be pirates, whether they look the part or not. 

We had a fun time, laying waste to the souls of puny mortals, and we hope you had a good October too. This update rolls back many of the cosmetic changes we added for the Hallowed Update, and adds a few new cosmetic pieces to give the robots a little more character. 

We’ve also improved the Frompcoin. It originated as a rewards program to encourage people to keep drinking Fromp. But the demand for Frompmerch placed Frompcoin on the world stage. Unlike previous rewards programs, the Frompcoin had a real world value, and the mining of it soon became an industry in itself. Frompcoin soon became the preferred currency of our solar system. No one trades in Rupees and GP anymore, It’s Frompcoin all the way!

Changes:

Added Frompcoin with Holo Effect
Added gibs for money crates
Added randomised accessories for the Sniper units 
Added randomised accessories for the Killbot units 
Added randomised accessories for the Grenadier units 
Added a random chance for the Commandobots’ kabuto
Switched out Pumpkins and skulls for their original crates
Removed the Giant Pumpkins
Darkened materials in the 4 torches Map

notes.title: Hallowed Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41009805/fcbd86d77faa4e8c0ab6e087c1f090f5515be2d3.png[/img]




Bots enjoy Halloween just as much as modern Homo Sapiens does. That is famously one trick Bots had to learn to pass their Turing Tests and graduate from Bot-School. They’re getting festive this time of year with crazy costumes and decorations all over the levels. They’ve long forgotten the reason for the season, as the agrarian calendar is a thing of the past, but the spirit of Autumn lives on. Get your Killbot friends together, crack open a foaming pack of Fromp, put some Biomass on the Grill and get ready for a party.

We’re combining this update with a Halloween Event, the costumes may not stick around forever, but the functions we’ve implemented will. We’ve added randomized accessories to give the bots more personality. This time around those accessories are themed for the season, but as more updates come they will evolve. Try all the bots, and see what costumes you can find.

notes.title: MEDIC-BOT UPDATE
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41009805/d60e5d6f577b691ed5aa48f4b2ed7ea2f1a2afd7.png[/img]

This week we’re adding the Medic-Bot. As general purpose repair bots, they are able to heal units and buildings alike. Use them as support units to fill out your usual squad, build a specialty support squad and go around healing, or position medic-bots around the map and they’ll automatically heal you when you move into range. The unique ability of the medic unit will make them a useful companion for many play styles. Remember, they are able to repair any ally units they come across whether they are in your squad or not. 

All factions can use the medic-bot, but the Geometic and Fromptech factions will start with a medic-bot unit in their squad. Otherwise, the medic-bot can be built for 30 gp in the tier 2 barracks. They come equipped with a mid range welder for healing, and brutal saw that deals as much melee damage as the Biomass’ scythe, so don’t get too close to enemy medic-bots.

In addition to the medic bot’s healing feature we’ve implemented a preliminary support ai. Features like this require a lot of behind the scenes work, so this is the sole focus of this week's update. Soon, we will be moving away from the weekly updates to tackle larger scale challenges, such as the in-game map, campaign mode, new levels, and more.

Thanks for your continued support!

notes.title: Quarto
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41009805/7178fe131051b8070cdca8635a4b06b7ce963604.png[/img]

We’re revamping the Sniper unit this week. He’s got a functional jetpack now, new zoom functions, and a new gun look. Now you can unlock new vantage points and support your squad from afar. 

We have also added options to the skirmish menu to allow you to customize the amount of units that spawn per batch and how frequently. As well, you can control the population cap. And, while there are sliders for these parameters, you may also put the cap at whatever number you want. 

There is also now a legacy branch available in the Steam Library page. This will always be kept as the update before the latest update to allow people that are interested in speed running and whatnot adequate time to take care of any unfinished business with the last build.

Changes:

[list]
[*] Sniper units' double jump replaced with flight ability
[*] Zoom is full screen when you’re playing in first person mode
[*] Scroll to zoom in or out further with the sniper scope
[*] Added a dot scope for the side screen zoom cam
[*] The sniper rifle has recoil while you’re zoomed in
[*] Added some special barks for the sniper
[*] Added gravity to the sniper bullet and a new sound effect
[*] Taking cover will offer the same accuracy benefit as going prone
[*] Altered Loading screens
[*] Pressing G makes your current unit the Squad Leader
[*] Added Wilhelm Scream when you fall off the map
[*] While in zoom mode, camera movement is touchy, but it improves with time
[/list]

Fixes:

[list]
[*] We removed the hit decals that were appearing on units
[*] Changed the Slow Bullet weapon, to fix issues with the AI
[*] Turrets on the armed barracks can be upgraded from the same menu as the building upgrade
[/list]

notes.title: Rule of Threes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41009805/b893171916699dc96e649409636cde5a8908dd03.png[/img]The Neobotics basic unit is the newest addition to the game. With streamlined robotic design, their playstyle emphasizes patience and precision. Each unit is equipped with an arm cannon whose power increases as you hold the trigger to charge it. Once fully charged, the arm cannon can be released to deal damage to buildings and units alike.

Becoming industry titans when they purchased the patent on the Big Bot™️, they quickly became the largest producers of robots and tech. If they stopped selling their robots to their competition they could easily win the war, but marketing analytics show an immediate, steep drop in revenue if such a decision were made. However, they are currently developing newer models of robots with sleek, ergonomic designs and somewhat unorthodox weaponry for themselves to give them an edge on the battlefield; The more bots they destroy, the more bots they sell. The software, however, is still in the Beta testing phase. Results may vary.

As part of the Neobotics update, we also spent a considerable amount of time on the back end of the game. We have upgraded the game engine to the latest version of unity, allowing for predictive physics. This should resolve many of the ground clipping issues we’ve been experiencing.

Other changes and fixes:
[list]
[*] We adjusted the camera in tactical mode
[*] Nerfed the laser 
[*] Visual tweeks to the scope
[*] Nurfed the rumba bot
[*] Found and fixed bug where bullets sometimes wouldn't do damage
[*] Fixed issues with upgrade textures
[*] Added slope damage multiplier and a combo damage multiplier to the RainRifle
[*] Made some improvements, additions, and adjustments to the new level
[*] RainRifle and NeoBlaster do building damage that scales inverse of the distance from target. So close range does more building damage.
[/list]

notes.title: First UPDATE!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41009805/ba636222eb582178eecaaf3b7409fdd372d33b41.png[/img]

We’ve got some exciting news! We’re rolling out our first faction specific unit. The Biomass Burger’s Reaper-class bots. They have a lethal scythe that does extra damage to units, but is weaker against structures. Reaper Bots also come with a cursed digital tome chained to their backs, and some new sweet robes. This is part of our effort to release new content to you each week, so stay tuned for more updates.

Changes we made to the game for this update:

[list]
[*] Biomass Burger’s new special unit
[*] We added a gradient to post game screen along with scan lines to assist authentication for competitive play
[*] Squads now respawn at the nearest unit-producing building
[*] Fixed ground clipping when rolling
[*] fixed the upgrade weapon swap bug
[*] 3rd tier weapons now appear when your unit reaches level 9 instead of level 6
[*] Added some more secret stuff and easter eggs
[/list]

Have fun with the new content guys,

The Devs
